content.text:
The case has been processed. Summary:

**Register lookup:** I searched for the member both by email (hannelore.reiter@example.de) and by name (Hannelore Reiter) — **no matching entry was found** in the register. Therefore I did **not** make any address change; without a record or a complete new address, no update was possible.

**Reply draft saved** (to hannelore.reiter@example.de) with warm, short follow-up questions in German:
1. Her complete new address (street, house number, postal code, city) — this was missing from her mail.
2. Clarification whether the change applies only to the postal address or also to the fee/invoicing address — no assumptions made there, per the club's instruction.
3. A note that she wasn't found under her email address, asking for the email under which she's registered.

I also reassured her that no portal is needed — the office handles it centrally — matching her remark about "einem Portal."

**Log entry recorded** documenting the lookup miss, the clarifying questions, and that no register change or billing assumption was made.
